inputs.text: [excited] MY… kroh… RAP… tor. "Micro," in Greek, [serious] means tiny — like a microbe. And "raptor" is thief. [curious] So?
[happily] Exactly. [proud] It lived in China, in Asia, one hundred twenty million years ago.
[gasps] Is it the smallest raptor you know about?
[amazed] One of the smallest dinosaurs ever found, yes. [playful] And it has a secret nobody else has.
